questions.question: What is the subtitle of the third Pirates of the Caribbean film?
questions.note: 2007. Dead Man’s Chest is the second; On Stranger Tides is the fourth.

questions.question: What is the subtitle of the second Captain America film in the MCU?
questions.note: 2014, by the Russo brothers. Civil War is the third Cap-headlined film.

questions.question: What is the subtitle of Tom Holland’s second Spider-Man film?
questions.note: 2019, set after Endgame. Homecoming is the first; No Way Home is the third.

questions.question: The Hangover Part II is set in which city?
questions.note: 2011. The first and third films return to Las Vegas.

questions.question: What 2017 sequel to Ridley Scott’s 1982 sci-fi film is titled with a year?
questions.note: Denis Villeneuve directed; Ryan Gosling stars alongside Harrison Ford.

questions.question: What is the subtitle of Terminator 3?
questions.note: 2003, with Arnold and a T-X. Judgment Day is the subtitle of T2.

questions.question: Which 2014 X-Men film sends characters back to the 1970s?
questions.note: Bryan Singer; Hugh Jackman, Jennifer Lawrence, and a young/old Magneto split.

questions.question: In which Harry Potter film is the Triwizard Tournament held?
questions.answer: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
choices: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
questions.note: 2005 — dragons, the maze, and a graveyard return.

questions.question: What is the subtitle of the second Hobbit film?
choices: The Battle of the Five Armies
questions.note: 2013. Five Armies wrapped the trilogy in 2014.

questions.question: In the John Wick films, what is the name of the hotel that serves as a sanctuary for assassins?
questions.note: Rules of the hotel: no “business” on Continental grounds.
